notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla ships the three reference mirror-timer bars (breath/fatigue/feign-death) driven by SMSG_START/PAUSE/STOP_MIRROR_TIMER through the MIRROR_TIMER_* FrameXML events with client-side value+rate integration. MSUIClient has nothing: a repo-wide grep for MIRROR finds no opcode, no decoder, and no bar UI. Swimming underwater produces no breath bar and no drowning warning surface.
